description: The RPG set, but real-time combat + boss encounters + loot-driven build diversity. Merge with 'rpg' for the full set; this file overrides combat to real-time and adds action milestones.

combat.desc: Real-time combat: hit reactions, i-frames, dodge/roll, lock-on targeting, telegraphs, combos (a heavy feel milestone).

boss_encounters.desc: Phased boss fights with telegraphed attacks.

loot_build_diversity.desc: Loot drops enabling distinct viable builds (LootTable + itemization).

enemy_scaling.desc: Enemy difficulty scales with progression / area.

starter_scaffold.notes: real-time controller + one enemy + one dodge + one loot drop

starter.description: Action-RPG starter - a flat arena for real-time combat prototyping.
